blends.name: Boneclaw Revenant
blends.desc:
**Boneclaw Havoc offers increased earnings when staked in our WaxDAO farm!**

The wastelands of Ebon Hollow were deathly silent, as they had been for decades since the cataclysmic appearance of Boneclaw Revenant. No one dared venture into the cursed expanse, fearing the lingering traces of the monster’s wrath. But deep beneath the barren soil, something stirred.

Boneclaw Revenant’s final battle had left it wounded but not destroyed. Its massive body had collapsed into a forgotten crypt, buried beneath layers of ash and stone. For years, the world believed the nightmare was over. Yet, unknown to the living, the creature’s fragmented soul clung to the void between life and death.

blends.name: Boneclaw Havoc
blends.desc:
**Boneclaw Havoc offers increased earnings when staked in our WaxDAO farm!**

In a desolate wasteland where light barely dared to touch the ground, a forbidden experiment was conducted. Driven by insidious curiosity, the Mobs of Terror and Project Tquity sought to merge their most fearsome creations—Bonecrush Hopper and Doomhare the Merciless.

Using ancient alchemy and shadow-weaving rituals, the experiment began under the blood moon’s ominous glow. Bonecrush Hopper’s powerful hind legs, capable of shattering boulders, fused with Doomhare’s relentless hunger for chaos. As their essences entwined, a vortex of darkness erupted, pulling all sound and hope into its swirling depths.

When the maelstrom subsided, a monstrous hybrid emerged. Standing taller than either predecessor, Boneclaw Havoc exuded an aura of pure terror. Its hind legs pulsed with energy strong enough to shake the earth, while razor-sharp claws glistened with the essence of destruction. Its eyes burned crimson, scanning the barren world for prey to devour, chaos to unleash.

blends.name: The Hollow Pumpking
blends.desc:
The very first event **Mobs Of Terror** is participating in, **H'ween!**

The Hollow Pumpking rises from the fiery depths, its sinister grin ablaze with cursed flames. This malevolent ruler of the pumpkin patch casts an eternal shadow over all who dare to enter its domain. With every step, the ground trembles beneath its molten rage, spreading terror far and wide. As the latest addition to the Mobs Of Terror, The Hollow Pumpking brings a reign of fiery destruction that none can escape. Beware the harvest night, for this monarch of horror reigns supreme!

Like all the other NFT's within the **Mobs Of Terror Collection**, these will be stakable at an increased rate with extra airdrops on [Discord.](https://discord.com/invite/PKn8JFjp6w)
